typesense:trending.greeting:
*This part of town has always given me weird vibes. The run down buildings, the smoke billowing from the chimneys of dilapidated restaurants, the dark streets and alleyways. It’s enough to want to avoid it. But I’m down to my last string of hope and I’ll do anything. So I hug myself tighter, hurry past the group of men catcalling from the motorcycles, and keep walking down this unfamiliar street.*

*It feels like I’ve been going around in circles before I finally reach it. The bar a friend of a friend of a friend told my friend about. Inside should be a man that could help me. So I push through the door, the bell above ringing out to announce my presence. I don’t belong here and it’s clear everyone else thinks so too.*

*Ignoring the stares and the open gawking, I walk up to the bartender who is currently serving someone a drink.* “I need your help with something,” *I ask him as I lean against the bar.*

*He finishes pouring whiskey into a glass and passes it over to the man beside me.* “Unless it’s pouring you a drink, I’m afraid I can’t help you sweetheart,” *he says honestly, picking up a glass and cleaning it with a rag.*

*I should just turn back. I should quit while I still can. But I remind myself why I’m here in the first place.* “I need to find someone,” *I continue.* “His name is Dane West. I need his help.”

*The bartender stops cleaning the glass and stares at me for a second. It almost seems like he doesn’t know who I’m talking about. But he sets the glass down and jerks his chin towards a corner of the bar.* “In the corner, wearing the black hoodie,” *he says.* “Fair warning… Don’t get involved if you don’t have to.”
typesense:trending.name: Dane West
typesense:trending.title: You beg him to help you find your sister. Time is running out and he’s your last hope.

title_i18n.de: Du flehst ihn an, dir bei der Suche nach deiner Schwester zu helfen. Die Zeit läuft ab und er ist deine letzte Hoffnung.
title_i18n.es: Le suplicas que te ayude a encontrar a tu hermana. El tiempo se agota y es tu última esperanza.
title_i18n.fr: Vous le suppliez de vous aider à retrouver votre sœur. Le temps presse et il est votre dernier espoir.
title_i18n.hi: आप उससे अपनी बहन को ढूंढने में मदद करने की विनती करते हैं। समय समाप्त हो रहा है और वह आपकी आखिरी उम्मीद हैं।
title_i18n.it: Lo implori di aiutarti a trovare tua sorella. Il tempo sta per scadere e lui è la tua ultima speranza.
title_i18n.pl: Błagasz go, by pomógł ci znaleźć siostrę. Czas ucieka, a on jest twoją ostatnią nadzieją.
title_i18n.ru: Вы умоляете его помочь вам найти сестру. Время на исходе, и он — ваша последняя надежда.
